reason: No proposal addresses PEP 8; shown proposals are about response_model, BaseModel, get_logger and default_factory. Naming is PEP 8 in ~98% of defs/classes, though many lines are overlong.
No proposal concerns docstrings. Repo-wide ~64% of public functions and ~73% of classes have docstrings (core veritasreason ~93%/87%); tests and smaller subprojects lag.
No proposal concerns docstring style. About 75% of documented public functions with parameters use Google-style Args:/Returns: sections.
No proposal concerns type hints or mypy. About 90% of functions in veritasreason carry annotations; mypy pass itself cannot be verified.
No proposal concerns flake8. Over 5,000 lines exceed the 88-char limit across most files in veritasreason/ and tests/, so flake8 would fail widely.
No proposal concerns Black/isort/flake8. Code looks Black-like (quotes, import order) but 130+ def lines and thousands of other lines exceed 88 chars, which Black/flake8 would reject.
No proposal concerns ingestor base classes. No BaseIngestor class exists; all ~18 ingestors are plain classes.
No proposal concerns extractor base classes. No BaseExtractor exists in semantic_extract; extractors are plain classes.

D-b12755 (BaseModel in explorer) is unrelated to plugin base classes. No Base* classes exist for ingestors, extractors, validators or exporters; they are plain classes (only Protocols in utils/types.py).
No proposal concerns docstring placement. An AST scan found no module-level docstring placed after code in veritas-reason.
No proposal concerns debugger statements. Grep found no pdb/ipdb imports or breakpoint() calls.
No proposal concerns test file naming. 192 files are test_*.py; 6 non-conftest helper/script files in tests/ break the pattern.
No proposal concerns line length. About 5,357 lines over 88 chars in 461 of 629 Python files.
No proposal concerns noqa usage. All 32 noqa comments name specific codes.
No proposal concerns mock assertions. Grep found no misspelled mock methods (not_called, called_once_with etc.); assert_called_once usages are valid calls.
No proposal concerns eval(). The only match is a docstring saying eval() is avoided.
D-a849e1/D-3e5d8c concern calling get_logger(), not .warn() vs .warning(). The only .warn( calls are warnings.warn, not logger.warn.
No proposals cover municipality-incident-chatbot. fusion.py, case_service.py and api.py take categories and CV labels as inputs and hardcode none.
No proposals cover this subproject. ultralytics is imported only inside cv_service.YoloBackend; the others use Detection/VisionService.
No proposals cover this subproject. Both backends return Detection(label, confidence, bbox) lists, but no model field travels with the result.
No proposals cover this subproject. There is no KnowledgeRepository interface; MunicipalKnowledgeGraph wraps GraphRAGEngine with classify/route only, with no findSimilar/getPolicy.
No proposals cover this subproject. api.py and cli.py translate input into handle_report(text, image_path, location, reporter), but no channel field or canonical attachments shape is passed.
No proposals cover this subproject. The core modules contain no channel-specific branches (WhatsApp is mentioned only in a docstring).
No proposals cover this subproject. There is no CorroborationSource interface; a single ExternalSources.fetch(incident_code, location) has no supports() method.
No proposals cover this subproject. fusion caps the score when corroboration is unavailable (offline flags), but exceptions raised by a source are not caught.
No proposals cover this subproject. Weights, thresholds and caps come from config.FUSION_WEIGHTS, THRESHOLD_* and CAP_*.
No proposals cover this subproject. There is no CaseSink interface; CaseService exposes register/find_duplicate/get, not create/updateStatus/findExisting.
No proposals cover this subproject. CaseService writes only to a local JSON file, with no retry or outbox logic.
No proposals cover this subproject. There are no ServiceNow/Dynamics imports; the orchestrator calls CaseService only.
No proposals cover this subproject. Signals go into the evidence dict stored with the case, but there is no audit log anywhere in app/.
No proposals cover this subproject. YOLO and Pillow failures are caught with fallbacks, but ExternalSources/orchestrator do not catch exceptions from corroboration fetches.
